prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 1：TOEFL_Independent 核心章节连写】参照全文样板 `FT24 (托福独立写作满分范文：生成模型训练中坚守真实人类语料锚点与防止模型自噬（Model Autophagy）)` 的段落蓝图链 `BP33 -> BP35 -> BP39`，围绕你自己的研究方向（深度学习 / 时间序列 / 生成模型 / 具身智能）写出连续 3 个逻辑咬合的自然段，并标注段间过渡钩子（`L027`）。
source_material_or_draft: In conclusion, we proposed DyTS-Net in this paper. It has a spectral module and an ODE module. Experiments show that it achieves state-of-the-art performance on many datasets. We hope our work will inspire more researchers in the future.
structural_constraints: S1 [核心科学问题闭合 Scientific Closure]：In this paper, we addressed the fundamental tension between [Goal A] and [Goal B] in [Domain].
S2 [方法论精髓回顾 Methodological Synthesis]：By introducing [Model/Mechanism], we demonstrated that [Core Insight] enables [Capability] without incurring [Traditional Penalty].
S3 [实证结果高度概括 Empirical Recap]：Comprehensive evaluations across [Benchmarks/Hardware] confirmed consistent error reductions of up to [X%] alongside substantial inference speedups.
S4 [跨领域迁移展望 Broader Outlook]：Beyond [Current Task], our [Core Principle] offers a generalizable blueprint for broader sequential decision-making tasks under non-stationary environments.
target_defects_to_fix: 过度名词化僵尸句 + 被动语态滥用（Over-Nominalization & Passive Abuse）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例

genre_target: IELTS Academic Task 1 首段（Introduction + Overview）或实验趋势总览段
domain_context: 非平稳时间序列预测与分布漂移消除
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写雅思 Task 1 或数据报告的第一段：用同义句法改写图表标题，并用两句话高度凝练全图最核心的 2 个宏观趋势（极值、反超拐点或主次格局），绝不堆砌零碎数字。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 2：整篇小作文 / 演讲 / Rebuttal 闭环构建】结合今日所学蓝图 `BP25` 与全文样板 `FT24` 的后半部分（`BP38 -> BP40`），完成一篇包含“破题/总起 → 核心机制/正方论证 → 让步反驳/消融归因 → 边界收束”的完整短文，并用 `L030` 七维自检表逐项核验。
source_material_or_draft: Many researchers have studied this problem. Wu et al. used Autoformer. Nie et al. used PatchTST. They are very good, but they all think the data distribution does not change, which is wrong in real life.
structural_constraints: S1 [图表命题同义改写 Prompt Paraphrase]：The line graph / bar chart compares [Variable/Metric] across [Categories/Regions] over a [N]-year period from [Year A] to [Year B].
S2 [宏观趋势 1：总体走向与反超 Overview Trend 1]：Overall, while [Category A and B] experienced a steady upward trajectory, [Category C] declined markedly, leading to a reversal in dominance around [Mid-Year].
S3 [宏观趋势 2：极值或差距特征 Overview Trend 2]：Notably, [Category A] registered the most dramatic growth throughout the period, ultimately overtaking all other sectors to become the primary contributor.
target_defects_to_fix: 重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例
